why: Leaves the moment scene's muzzle smoke on full motion whatever the policy, as it was before issue #1018: under reduced motion the cloud should be fully grown and still from its first tick (`travel` 0, `grow` 1), and a `--motion reduced` frame would instead show it drifting and spreading. Killed by the wiring case that records what each system is pushed under a reduced policy.
killedBy: buildMomentScene wiring (issue #1018) pushes a reduced motion policy to the barrel recoil and the muzzle smoke
